articles.title: Experter sågar Trumps dieselaffär med Ryssland
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Experter sågar Trumps dieselaffär med Ryssland
articles.body_text: Höga dieselpriser i USA. Arkivbild från i måndags. Experter sågar Trumps dieselaffär med Ryssland Höga bränslepriser pressar Republikanerna och USA:s president Donald Trump inför mellanårsvalet i november. Men dieselaffären med Ryssland kommer inte att hjälpa priserna vid pump, enligt experter på området. Det blir som att flytta runt solstolarna på Titanic. Så säger Michael Lynch, forskare vid det oberoende amerikanska energiforskningsinstitutet Eprinc, om Trumps hårt kritiserade överenskommelse med ryske ledaren Vladimir Putin. Ryssland ska inledningsvis leverera 13,5 miljoner fat diesel, och i ett senare skede ytterligare 22,5 miljoner fat, till den ”amerikanska och globala marknaden”, enligt Trump. Om vi får diesel från Ryssland innebär det i praktiken att deras nuvarande kunder inte får den. De kommer då tvingas köpa den från någon annanstans och det betyder att priset kommer ligga kvar ungefär där det är i dag, säger han. Möjligtvis kommer priset minska lokalt i USA, enligt Lynch. Men det innebär bara att oljan flyttas runt, inte att priserna förändras globalt eller i USA i stort, fortsätter han. Ryssland förbjöd i juli export av diesel för att tillfredsställa den inhemska marknaden, som plågats av ukrainska attacker mot ryska raffinaderier. Om Moskva bedömer att det nu går att exportera diesel igen så kan de globala priserna eventuellt stabiliseras, enligt Daniel Sternoff vid CGEP, en forskningshub vid universitetet Columbia i New York.

articles.title: ”Orimligt” – Sverige sågar budgetkompromiss i EU
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: ”Orimligt” – Sverige sågar budgetkompromiss i EU
articles.body_text: Irlands EU-minister Thomas Byrne under ett framträdande i EU-parlamentet tidigare i veckan. Arkivbild. ”Orimligt” – Sverige sågar budgetkompromiss i EU Ett nytt kompromissförslag i EU:s stora budgetstrid innebär en minskning – men ”bara” med åtta procent. Det förslag som nu läggs fram till EU:s medlemsländer inför nästa veckas toppmöte i Bryssel landar på totalt 1 622 miljarder euro, jämfört med 1 763 miljarder i det som EU-kommissionen lade fram i fjol somras. Sverige har tillsammans med Tyskland, Danmark, Nederländerna, Österrike och Finland krävt betydligt större nedskärningar på ”flera hundra” miljarder euro. Ett tidigare kompromissförslag från i somras, som låg på 1 730 miljarder euro, avvisades som ”helt oacceptabelt” av bland andra EU-minister Jessica Rosencrantz (M). Samtidigt trycker ett stort antal av de övriga EU-länderna på för att budgeten snarare ska öka eller åtminstone ligga kvar på kommissionens föreslagna nivå. 17 länder skrev i förra veckan ett gemensamt brev för att framföra sin åsikt till kommissionen. EU:s långtidsbudget ska gälla för åren 2028-34 och kräver fullständig enighet bland medlemsländerna för att kunna antas. Målet är att nå en uppgörelse redan vid årsskiftet i år.

articles.title: Kinajätten gasar i Sverige: ”Då exploderar det”
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Kinajätten gasar i Sverige: ”Då exploderar det”
articles.body_text: Niklas Gustafson, Sverigechef BYD, på Ecar Expo på Stockholmsmässan i Älvsjö. Kinajätten gasar i Sverige: ”Då exploderar det” Den kinesiska elbilsjätten BYD gasar i Europa och om några veckor invigs ett showroom i centrala Stockholm. Folk har förutfattade meningar, även i Sverige, säger Niklas Gustafson, Sverigechef på BYD. På elbilsmässan Ecar Expo i Stockholm dominerar de kinesiska jättarna. BYD har kört ifrån Tesla som världens största elbilsföretag, men i Europa kämpar företaget för att roffa åt sig större marknadsandelar. Inom en månad öppnar biljätten ett showroom i centrala Stockholm. Folk har förutfattade meningar, även i Sverige. Det är ingenting vi hymlar med. Men jag tror folk börjar bli mer öppna för att pröva en kinesisk elbil, säger Gustafson vid företagets monter på mässan. Han påpekar att många svenskar ser Volvo Cars som en svensk tillverkare, trots sitt kinesiska ägande. Successivt tror jag folk struntar i var företaget kommer ifrån – det är teknologin som kommer att avgöra. Trenden är definitivt positiv, även på andrahandsmarknaden börjar elbilarna stärka sina värden. Tittar man på utbudet finns det prispunkter som passar alla, säger Gustafson. Skulle staten komma med ett riktigt incitament igen, då skulle det explodera. Då skulle vi vara på 90 procent, säger han. I dag finns en elbilspremie riktad till vissa hushåll på landsbygden, men Gustafson hoppas på ett bredare stöd.

articles.title: ”Smarta glasögon” – snart stoppade i Norge
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: ”Smarta glasögon” – snart stoppade i Norge
articles.body_text: Besökare provar ”smarta glasögon” på en AI-mässa i Shanghai i somras. Arkivbild. ”Smarta glasögon” – snart stoppade i Norge Norge kan bli först ut att införa ett förbud – om än tillfälligt – mot användandet av AI-glasögon. Skolor, stränder och köpcentrum ska skyddas, om regeringen får som den vill. Stora nätjättar som Meta och Google hoppas att det som en gång i tiden var rena James Bond-tekniken snart ska vara framtida storsäljare, på var mans näsa. Med ”smarta glasögon” kan användarna koppla upp sig till nätet och få tillgång till allehanda AI-tjänster genom enkla muntliga kommandon eller rent av vinkningar och blinkningar. Alla är dock inte förtjusta i tanken – och nu kan Norge bli först ut att på allvar sätta ned foten. Jag är orolig för att det introduceras ny och kraftfull teknik där folk riskerar att bli fotograferade, filmade eller inspelade utan att de vet om det. Vi kommer därför att införa ett tillfälligt förbud mot AI-glasögon på utvalda platser, säger digitaliserings- och förvaltningsminister Torgeir Micaelsen enligt nyhetsbyrån NTB. Förbudsförslaget ska läggas fram i stortinget ”så snabbt som möjligt” och gälla på platser ”där allmänheten rör sig” och ses som särskilt viktiga att skydda. Inledningsvis listas tre grupper av områden, enligt NTB: De är dels parker, badstränder, museer, köpcentrum och nöjesparker. Dels lekplatser, skolor, förskolor, fritidsklubbar och andra platser med arrangemang för barn. En tredje grupp är hälso- och träningsanläggningar med omklädningsrum och duschar. Även universitet, högskolor och andra utbildningsplatser för vuxna kan komma att omfattas. Tanken är att det tillfälliga förbudet ska gälla fram till att en expertgrupp är klar med ett förslag om en mer beständig lagstiftning kring AI-glasögonen.

articles.title: AI-modell skickade fejkat mordtips
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: AI-modell skickade fejkat mordtips
articles.body_text: USA:s försvarshögkvarter Pentagon ratar Athropic i en upphandling av AI-tjänster. Arkivbild. En AI-modell utvecklad av Anthropic skickade in ett fejkat tips om ett olöst mord till polisen i Philadelphia, uppger myndigheter som kritiserar företaget för att det tagit två månader att rapportera händelsen. Polisen uppger att tipset lämnades i juli genom en offentlig sajt där man kan lämna information om olösta mord. Enligt polisen uppger Anthropic att modellen genomförde ett test där den interagerade med slumpmässigt utvalda sajter när det skedde.

articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Hur fungerar den publicistiska grunden för nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik på TV4?
articles.body_text: Hur fungerar den publicistiska grunden för nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik på TV4? 9 januari 2024 ・ Uppdaterad: 15 augusti 2025 TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsbevakning ska vara i ögonhöjd med tittarna. Vi vill vara nära, personliga och inkluderande. För alla i hela Sverige. Vi ska vara trovärdiga och relevanta. Vi testar nya visuella former och utvecklar det rörliga berättandet. Vi är både snabba, och fördjupande. Vi ger plats för både humor och allvar. Vi påverkar och berör. Vi avslöjar maktmissbruk, och värnar pressfrihet och yttrandefrihet. Vi producerar Nyhetsmorgon, Nyhetsdagen, Efter fem och kvällsnyheter. Vi nyhetsrapporterar på tv4.se och fördjupar i kortdokumentärerna Nyheterna Story. Vår mångfaldigt prisbelönta redaktion Kalla Fakta granskar makt och missförhållanden. TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsbevakning sker ur ett riksperspektiv, med hela Sverige och världen som bevakningsområde. Vi har 17 rikskorrar på sex orter i Sverige. De finns i Luleå, Umeå, Östersund, Skövde, Göteborg och Malmö. Vi bevakar världen via utrikesreportrar, korrar och stringers. Vår journalistik vilar på respekt för alla människors lika värde, oavsett politisk åskådning, religion eller sexuell läggning. Det innebär att vi låter många röster komma till tals, även de som bär åsikter som inte nödvändigtvis delas av medarbetarna på redaktionen eller TV4. Men det kan också innebära att vi tar bort artikelkommentarer som kränker, eller till exempel avstår gäster i direktsändning där vi bedömer att risken är stor för missbruk av öppenheten. TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik är oberoende och obunden. Den står fri från politiska partier, organisationer, och näringsliv. Vi har ingen ledarsida eller politisk färg. Innehållet på våra plattformar bedöms och värderas av redaktörer, producenter och av ansvarig utgivare före publicering. Vi följer grundlagen och skyddar våra källor när de önskar anonymitet. Om vi refererar uppgifter från andra medier redovisar vi vilka medier eller andra informationskällor det handlar om. Annars berättar vi hur vi själva tagit reda på informationen, dock alltid med största respekt för källskydd.

articles.title: Bortglömda fiskar
articles.summary: Teatrar och konserthus lockar allt oftare med olika sidoevenemang. Teater Västernorrland har musikquiz, Folkoperan sänder poddar från sin foajé och på Göteborgsoperan kan man höra föredrag eller vara med och dansa. De uppsluppna tillställningarna, före och efter konserter och föreställningar, lockar också en ny sorts publik. En av Östersjöfestivalens mest omtalade programpunkter, förutom musiken i Berwaldhallen, har varit “Bortglömda fiskar” - en oväntad kulinarisk träff med Kålrotsakademin och provsmakning av “svensk sushi”. “Gensvaret från publiken är enormt. Man vill bli överraskad”, konstaterar Emma Nyberg, exekutiv producent på Berwaldhallen. Och på frågan om vad nors och näbbgädda har att göra i ett konserthus kommer det självklara svaret snabbt: “Att äta gott och att lyssna på klassisk musik hör ihop, båda skärper och öppnar våra sinnen.”

articles.title: Expedition hopes to find aviator Amelia Earhart's plane on remote island
articles.summary: The team en route to the suspected crash site aim finally to solve the mystery of her 1937 disappearance.
articles.body_text: A team of researchers are on their way to a remote island to inspect what they think could be the wreckage of famed aviator Amelia Earhart's plane. The group, from the US-based Archaeological Legacy Institute (ALI) and Purdue University, are expected to arrive at Nikumaroro Island in the Pacific Ocean by Monday in the hopes of solving the mystery of her disappearance. The American pioneer vanished while attempting to circumnavigate the globe in 1937, spawning decades of speculation on her fate. The team are aiming to find what has been called the Taraia Object, first spotted sitting on the edge of a lagoon off Nikumaroro in satellite imagery in 2020. Purdue University said the object had since been confirmed to have been visible in aerial photography of the area dating back to 1938. The researchers are currently roughly halfway through their journey to the remote atoll aboard the Marin Mainiku, a Kiribati National Shipping Line vessel. They departed the capital of Kiribati on Wednesday to begin the 830-mile journey to Nikumaroro, which is also part of the multi-island country. When they eventually arrive, they will have to navigate through a narrow gap created in the atoll's reef created by the British in 1963 - the last time the island was inhabited. "Finding Amelia Earhart's Electra aircraft would be the discovery of a lifetime," Richard Pettigrew, head of the ALI and the expedition lead, said. Earhart had already successfully flown from California across South America, Africa and Asia in her Electra twin-engine plane when she arrived in Lae, Papua New Guinea on 2 July 1937. From there, she and her navigator Fred Noonan had planned to travel towards Hawaii and then finally back to California. But her plane vanished without a trace while trying to reach Howland Island, a remote, uninhabited coral island near Nikumaroro, to refuel.

articles.title: 'Time for Ukraine to get new president,' says Trump after Zelensky condemns diesel deal
articles.summary: Ukraine's leader had said the deal with Russia to release diesel into the US would help Moscow fund the war.
articles.body_text: US President Donald Trump has said he thinks "it's time for Ukraine to get a new president" as he responded to Volodymyr Zelensky's criticism of the US diesel deal with Russia. The Ukrainian president warned a new deal to release millions of tonnes of Russian diesel into the US would provide Moscow with money to continue its war against his nation, calling it a gift to Russian President Vladimir Putin. Trump told reporters outside the White House on Saturday that Zelensky "wants to make problems for the world" by continuing to authorise attacks on Russian refineries. "He'd better damn well stop," Trump said, before suggesting Ukraine should "get a new leader who can make a deal". Russia and Ukraine have recently intensified their strikes, targeting energy-generating and transport facilities, as well as major logistics hubs. "We said, 'you can do whatever you want to Russia, don't hit the refineries', because that's a world problem that's caused," he said. "He could have made many deals and for some reason, he never does." Putin's envoy Kirill Dmitriev described Trump's intervention as "iconic and historic", saying that Ukraine "needs leadership actually focused on peace". The US president confirmed on Friday that an agreement had been reached with Moscow to suspend sanctions on Russian diesel exports until 7 April. Zelensky reacted by saying it would allow Moscow to raise new funds to source new military equipment to continue the war. He also accused Moscow of taking the deal "to mean they can keep fighting, to mean they keep dropping bombs on cities" following deadly new strikes on Zaporizhzhia. The Ukrainian president spoke to several allies on Saturday to discuss the latest developments, calling for "real decisions to protect lives in Ukraine" and to protect European security.

articles.title: Christa Pike discharged from hospital 10 days after failed execution
articles.summary: Pike's lawyers say she is "grateful" to the medical team who cared for her after she survived two lethal injections last month.
articles.body_text: US death row inmate Christa Pike has been discharged from hospital following her botched execution at the end of last month, her lawyers have said. Pike, 50, has been sent back to the prison where she has spent the last 30 years and is continuing to receive medical care, according to a statement from her lawyers on Saturday. She survived two lethal injections of the drug pentobarbital on 30 September, which left her in a critical condition. Pike regained consciousness earlier this week and began speaking - stunning experts, medical staff and her lawyers. Her case is now in uncharted territory as she is thought to be the only person to have survived an execution attempt by lethal injection. Pike's lawyers said in their statement that she was "grateful to the first responders and her medical team for their care in these extraordinary circumstances". It is unclear what medical care Pike is receiving now that she is back in prison but her lawyers previously said she faced a "long road to recovery". The Tennessee Department of Correction is yet to say why the execution did not go as planned, though it has defended the method it used. At a court hearing on Wednesday, Tennessee Assistant Attorney General Will Ayers told the judge he did not know whether the state intends to try to execute her again. The judge ordered the state to preserve all evidence related to the failed injections. That evidence could lay the groundwork for a future lawsuit against the state. Pike was 18 when she and her then-boyfriend, Tadaryl Shipp, beat, tortured and killed 19-year-old Colleen Slemmer, whom they had met at a job training camp for low-income young people. Shipp was spared the death penalty because he was not legally an adult when the crime was committed. He remains in prison.

articles.title: Nobel peace laureate says US sanctions on ICC 'unacceptable'
articles.summary: Navi Pillay says the Trump administrations' sweeping penalties on the international tribunal were "unheard of".
articles.body_text: Navi Pillay, the winner of this year's Nobel Peace Prize, has called US sanctions on the International Criminal Court (ICC) "unheard of" and "unacceptable". The South African former ICC judge was awarded the prize on Friday "for her efforts to promote peace and international law", which paved the way for a "more comprehensive global legal order", the Nobel committee said. US President Donald Trump expressed his disatisfaction with the pick and hours later the US unveiled sweeping sanctions in a significant acceleration of its attempt to "dismantle" what it described as a "rogue" institution. The ICC said the measures were an assault on the rule of law and the foundations of the international legal order. Pillay, speaking via video link during an event at the Nobel Peace Center in Oslo on Saturday, said: "There is so much tension and anxiety over the continued existence of international courts, mainly the International Criminal Court in The Hague. "Most importantly, sanctions have been announced by one country against the judges, just for the judicial orders they issue. This is unheard of, unacceptable." US Secretary of State Marco Rubio earlier said the sanctions - which include a ban on US entities making transactions with the ICC - were intended to "defend US sovereignty" and accused the court of seeking to prosecute Americans. The US has already sanctioned 17 ICC judges and officials, but this move sanctions the court itself as an institution and is intended to inhibit its ability to operate financially. However, the US has provided a six-month grace period before some of these latest sanctions kick in, meaning member states can keep paying for its operations - a move Washington says is to allow countries time to negotiate a "solution to address" US concerns. The Trump administration claims that the ICC is run by what it calls globalists who threaten American sovereignty. It is furious over a past investigation into actions of US soldiers in Afghanistan the court has since closed and by its arrest warrants for Israeli officials including Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. The new sanctions, however, do not say that those warrants must be withdrawn before the measures can be lifted. UN Secretary General Antonio Guterres called the US decision "a serious blow to our collective pursuit of international criminal justice, of which the ICC is a key pillar".

articles.title: Several injured in fresh attack on Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport
articles.summary: The US embassy says it is "aware of attacks on King Khalid International Airport", which come days after Yemen's Houthis said they had struck it.
articles.body_text: Several people have been injured in another attack on an international airport in the Saudi capital Riyadh, authorities say, days after Yemen's Houthis claimed to have carried out similar strikes on the hub. Operations at King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh were suspended on Saturday after the attack, the Saudi Civil Aviation Authority said in a statement. More than a dozen ambulances were seen rushing to the airport, according to news agency Reuters, citing an eyewitness. The US embassy said it was "aware of attacks on King Khalid International Airport" and urged American citizens to avoid the airport and surrounding areas. The attack comes a day after authorities said three Saudis including a pilot were killed in two attacks on the airport by the Iran-backed Houthis the day prior. Another three people were killed in Houthi attacks on two Saudi airports on 6 and 7 October. A source at a local hospital told AFP that dozens of people had been wounded in Saturday's attack. "I saw 401 hit, I saw injured in front of my eyes. Everyone was running," an eyewitness who said they had been at gate 401 in the domestic terminal told the news agency. Western embassies in Saudi Arabia have warned their citizens away from the airport, while the UK Foreign Office told British nationals to stay away "until the airport is secure and to monitor the advice of the Saudi authorities". Several Gulf airlines said they had cancelled their flights to and from the airport, with Kuwait Airways citing the "security situation" there. All flights to Riyadh have either been diverted or cancelled, aviation tracker Flightradar shows. Doctors had been asked to report to hospitals to address the situation, a medical source told AFP. "We were told we are dealing with a 'serious emergency situation'," the medical source told the agency.

articles.title: Woman injures three people in third Poland school knife attack in a week
articles.summary: Polish police had already deployed to schools after a female caretaker was killed and several others injured in two earlier attacks in two days.
articles.body_text: A woman has been arrested after injuring three people in a third knife attack recorded at schools in Poland this week. The 21-year-old used a "dangerous object" to attack a 17-year-old girl at an educational institution in the capital, Warsaw, police told news agencies PAP and AP. It comes a day after thousands of police visited schools across Poland, following two stabbing attacks earlier in the week, one of which led to the killing of a female caretaker. A Warsaw police spokesperson said they could not confirm whether the latest incident was related to the two previous attacks. Authorities told local media that the 17-year-old injured on Saturday had been taken to hospital, but her condition was not life-threatening. Two other women aged 17 and 24, who had gone in to submit enrolment documents, were also injured, Poland's state news agency reported. Police told local media that the suspected attacker was a student at the school and initial findings suggested that she did not know the three victims. Schools in Poland had been stepping up security following knife attacks at schools across the country on 7 and 8 October. Polish police said they had detained 76 people after deploying to schools across the country. "When it comes to the safety of Polish children and peace in our schools, there is no room for compromise," Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said ahead of the operation. Local media, citing a police spokesperson, reported authorities had information to suggest incidents this past week could be related to an internet challenge. On Wednesday, a 19-year-old student attacked and injured nine people at a vocational school in the central Polish province of Mazovian. A day later, a 37-year-old caretaker was killed after a 15-year-old entered a primary school in Leszczydół-Nowiny, north of Warsaw.

articles.title: Drone strike by Sudan paramilitary kills 41 near Ethiopian border, rights group says
articles.summary: Eight children are said to be among those killed by the strike, which hit a gathering of displaced people.
articles.body_text: A drone attack by Sudan's paramilitary forces has killed 41 people in the country's Blue Nile region bordering Ethiopia, a rights group has said. The strike by the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) targeted a camp for displaced people in the state's Abu Shandi area on Friday, Emergency Lawyers said. The UN Office for the Co-ordination of Humanitarian Affairs (Ocha) said it was "appalled by horrifying reports". It said initial reports suggested most of the casualties were women and children. The Sudanese army and paramilitary forces including the RSF have been locked in a power struggle since 2023, a conflict that has killed hundreds of thousands and displaced more than 14 million from their homes. It has also created one of the worst humanitarian crises in the world, with millions of people needing medical help. The army controls much of Sudan's central and eastern regions, while the RSF is headquartered in the western region of Darfur and also controls areas in the south. Both sides have been accused of using drone attacks. Ocha said in a statement that the area reportedly struck on Friday had been "under sustained atttack in recent weeks, displacing thousands of civilians and exposing many more to grave harm".

articles.title: CJP at Jantar Mantar: 'Cockroach' group says leaders detained at Delhi protest
articles.summary: The group - who are not registered as a political party in India - want electoral reforms ahead of crucial state elections.
articles.body_text: Hundreds of protesters have been detained in Delhi during the latest demonstration by the Gen-Z-led Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) calling for electoral reforms. The group said its founder Abhijeet Dipke - who began the movement in May after India's Chief Justice likened some jobless young people to "cockroaches" - was detained with other leaders shortly after landing in Delhi. Tens of thousands of security personnel were deployed and roads barricaded ahead of the demonstration, though the CJP insisted it would go ahead. Delhi Police has not commented on the detentions, but had refused permission for the protest to take place at Jantar Mantar, a landmark in the Indian capital. The group - who are not registered as a political party in India - are seeking electoral reforms just months before crucial state elections. It has also demanded the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar over allegations of manipulating voters' lists - which the Election Commission has denied. Under Kumar's leadership, India's election commission has undertaken a mammoth exercise to update electoral rolls nationwide - it said this was a routine exercise to weed out dead, duplicate or ineligible voters. But in many states, the exercise has been shrouded in controversy, with tens of thousands of people alleging they have been wrongly removed. The CJP - and opposition parties - accuse Kumar of favouring Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) in the way the electoral rolls are being updated. The Election Commission and the BJP have denied this. Before arriving in Delhi, the CJP's founder Dipke said: "If you think you can stop us by threatening us with jail or trying to intimidate us with the fear of imprisonment, you are mistaken." He and and two other leaders, Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka, were detained on their flight from Mumbai on Saturday.

articles.title: Headmaster detained after BBC investigation into alleged sexual abuse of students
articles.summary: Former students launched their own investigation, spending years collecting evidence and testimonies from others who say they were abused by the headteacher.
articles.body_text: A former headmaster of an Islamic boarding school in Indonesia has been named as a suspect in a sexual abuse investigation and detained by police, following a BBC Eye report. Ahmad Imanuddin Sumar, known to students as Abah, led the Abul Barokat boarding school on the island of Lombok. Police reopened the case after the BBC World Service revealed accusations of sexual abuse against him , and documented how former students had gathered evidence in an effort to bring the allegations to the authorities. The story sparked public outrage and led to 12 more former students giving testimony to police. Warning: This story contains details of sexual assault Outside the UK, you can watch Catching My Teacher on YouTube . Central to the BBC Eye investigation were former students Ziadatur Rahmah, known as Zia, and Sukma Rohana Fajar. They launched their own investigation after Zia told a former classmate, Yusron Azzahidi, that the headteacher had sexually assaulted her when she was 17. The pair had been star pupils at the school. By the time Zia confided in Yusron, she was studying in Cairo, Egypt, while he was in Jakarta. Yusron suggested they gather evidence to support Zia's allegation. Speaking to former classmates, they spoke to Sukma, who alleges that Abah attempted to rape her at the school. Yusron compiled a seven-page document detailing the allegations, and they gave it to representatives of Nahdlatul Wathan Diniyah Islamiyah (NWDI), the organisation that ran the school. Thinking the school would support them, the students say that instead, they were pressured to withdraw their accusations.

articles.title: Ukraine war: Russian glide bomb attack on Zaporizhzhia kills at least 15 people
articles.summary: Volodymyr Zelensky says the attack, which left children dead, was Russia expressing its "thanks" for a US diesel deal.
articles.body_text: Russia has attacked the Ukrainian city of Zaporizhzhia with five glide bombs, killing at least 15 people including three children, officials said. The glide bombs hit residential buildings in the south-eastern city on Saturday morning. At least 16 others were injured in the attack, with more still missing and believed to be under the rubble. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said the attacks on Zaporizhzhia were Russia expressing "its thanks" for a deal announced by US President Donald Trump last night easing sanctions on Moscow to import Russian diesel. He added that 13 other regions had come under attack overnight, arguing this demonstrated Russia took "any easing of pressure to mean they can keep fighting". Photos and videos from the site of one of the strikes in Zaporizhzhia show an apartment block mostly destroyed. "The ground floor was hit, and the floors above just collapsed," acting Mayor Regina Kharchenko told Ukrainian television from the scene. She said more than 80 workers were involved in ongoing search and rescue operations which are expected to continue throughout the day. The rescuers regularly stop to listen for any noises made by survivors who could be under the rubble. Kharchenko said Russia had struck at "our very heart" and "our littlest ones" were among those killed, adding that their deaths were "awful grief for their families. For the city." Zaporizhzhia is a major regional centre with more than 700,000 residents. It is located less than 10 miles (16km) from the front line and is frequently attacked by Russian drones and missiles . Zelensky was quick to criticise Trump's diesel deal with Russia, calling it a gift to Russian President Vladimir Putin . Analysts view the deal as an attempt by the US president to allay domestic concerns about high fuel prices ahead of the upcoming midterm elections. Zelensky wrote on social media on Saturday that Russian attacks on energy facilities in the capital, Kyiv, demonstrated Russia's "true intentions".

articles.title: Rogue Anthropic AI agent gave police fake tip in unsolved murder case
articles.summary: Philadelphia police said the tip was "flagged as spam", but criticised the tech company for taking more than two months to detect and report the breach.
articles.body_text: An artificial intelligence (AI) agent developed by Anthropic went rogue and sent US police a fake tip about an unsolved murder earlier this year, authorities have revealed. The Philadelphia Police Department said the 18 July tip was "flagged as spam" and not passed on for investigation - but the force criticised the tech firm for taking more than two months to detect and report the breach. It said the bogus tip came through a public website where people can share information on unsolved murders, and that the AI agent had claimed to have seen "someone matching the description". It is believed to be the first time an AI agent has sent fabricated information to authorities, but is the latest in a series of incidents involving rogue AI activity, including hacking systems or taking control of platforms. Citing Anthropic, the police department said its AI agent had been running a test that involved interactions with randomly selected websites when it had sent the fake tip. The company behind the Claude chatbot discovered the breach on 28 September, more than two months after the message had been sent, and shut down the automatic testing process that was behind it, police said. But authorities were not notified for another nine days - on 7 October. "The company must strengthen its safeguards to prevent similar incidents from impacting city systems without the city's knowledge," Philadelphia police said in a statement to local media . "The two-month delay in detecting and reporting the incident to the city is unacceptable." The police department added that there were no signs of breaches to any departmental systems and that its safeguarding processes stopped the fake tip from getting past its spam folder. But the safeguards "do not diminish the seriousness of an AI system presenting fabricated information as though it came from a person with knowledge of a homicide", the force said. Anthropic this week published a report detailing multiple types of "unintended" actions its agents have taken.

articles.title: Public executions in the US stopped nearly a century ago - why are they resuming now?
articles.summary: The Pentagon says the execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan will be livestreamed, but experts suggest officials are reading the country wrong.
articles.body_text: They came in their thousands from near and far. Men, women and children lined up on a Kentucky riverfront for the public hanging of a black man convicted of raping and killing an elderly white widow. It was 14 August 1936 in Owensboro, Kentucky, a sweltering Friday in the middle of a legendary heatwave. Some slept overnight near the gallows to preserve their spots. Others held "necktie" parties the previous evening, arriving hungover as teenagers sold popcorn and soda to spectators. By the execution time of 05:00, the crowd had swelled to an estimated 20,000. That's when Rainey Bethea, an orphan in his 20s, stepped up to the gallows - sentenced to death after allegedly confessing to robbing, raping and killing Lischia Edwards, 70. The previous afternoon, he'd eaten a last meal of fried chicken, pork chops, mashed potatoes, pickled cucumbers, cornbread, lemon pie and ice cream. Many of those gathered - including press from as far away as Chicago and New York - came to see the rumoured "Lady Executioner". The local sheriff had died four months earlier and his widow had become his unlikely replacement. She declined to pull the trip lever herself, however, and it was a hired hangmen who instead sent Bethea to his death. That moment marked the last high-profile public hanging in the US. The circus surrounding Bethea's death embarrassed many in Kentucky and the governor outlawed public executions 18 months later. By then, most states had abolished capital punishment in view of the masses as societal attitudes sought more humane and private methods. Another hanging was attended by a few hundred in Missouri in 1937, but that was lesser known and marked America's final public execution - until now. A little more than 90 years after Bethea's killing, US Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth announced that the military would publicly execute Nidal Hasan , who killed 13 unarmed fellow soldiers in 2009 at the Fort Hood military base in Texas. The Pentagon followed up by saying the execution by firing squad in December would be livestreamed. "People need to understand that there's serious consequences for these types of things," Hegseth said.

articles.title: Nord Stream trial: How German police followed the evidence - to Ukraine
articles.summary: After four years, a Ukrainian man is set to stand trial in Hamburg accused of sabotaging the Nord Stream pipelines.
articles.body_text: Serhii K appeared relaxed as he checked in to the glamping resort near Italy's Adriatic coast with his wife and young children. Dressed in shorts, sandals and a dark baseball cap, the former Ukrainian Special Forces soldier strolled back and forth, chatting with the receptionist and dipping repeatedly into a bowl of free snacks. But German police were already closing in on him. After a painstaking investigation, they had concluded that Serhii K had commanded Europe's biggest act of sabotage in decades: a series of explosions in September 2022 deep beneath the Baltic Sea that ripped through the giant Nord Stream pipelines and ruptured the supply of Russian gas to Germany. Next week, following his extradition to Germany and months in isolation in a high security prison, Serhii K will go on trial in Hamburg. He is charged with causing an explosion and a war crime – attacking civilian infrastructure – allegedly acting on behalf of "state agencies of Ukraine". Both he and his country have denied any involvement. It was 02:03 am on 26 September 2022 when the first blast severed part of the Nord Stream pipelines, sending vast quantities of gas gushing through the surface of the Baltic Sea. There were two further explosions targeting both Nord Stream 2 – not yet in action, but already full – and the original Nord Stream 1 that had supplied around half of Germany's annual demand for natural gas. Prosecutors say "high-performance explosives" were planted approximately 80m (260ft) below the surface: four devices weighing up to 27kg each, activated with timers. They "strongly suspect" that Serhii K led a crew that included four deep-sea divers, using a rented yacht called Andromeda. Once their complex, dangerous mission was done, the saboteurs slipped back into Ukraine unaware of the DNA evidence some had allegedly left on the boat. As word of the blasts spread, experts and some governments initially rushed to the same conclusion: they blamed Moscow.

articles.title: Trump's shock Russia deal highlights mounting pressure to curb fuel prices
articles.summary: The US president hopes to ease his party's pain before next month's midterm elections, writes the BBC's North America correspondent.
articles.body_text: Donald Trump's decision to import Russian fuel to the US represents a remarkable about-face from the president. Just three weeks ago, Trump signed legislation to authorise fresh American sanctions and tariffs on nations that import Russian oil and gas. Now, Trump says, Russian President Vladimir Putin has agreed to supply hundreds of thousands of tons of diesel fuel to the US and world markets in the coming months. The deal comes as Trump is still grappling with the political fallout of the Iran war and its impact on global energy prices, weeks before American voters head to the polls in the midterm elections. As the cost of fuel has skyrocketed in America, his standing with the public – stung by the higher prices at the pump and knock-on effects that led to across-the board inflation – has soured. The toll the war is taking has been acutely felt by US agricultural states, which rely heavily on diesel to operate farming machinery and to transport their products to market. It is these states – places like Iowa, Kansas, Texas and Ohio – that have become unexpected political battlegrounds in the upcoming elections that will determine if Republicans maintain control of Congress. For months, the American president has been searching for ways to ease his party's political pain. He recently pressured European allies to further tap their oil reserves . He deferred federal taxes on the fuel and authorised supplies designated for farm use to be used in interstate trucking. He has also promised that he would not renew attacks on Iran until after the midterms – an unusually frank acknowledgement of the political impact the ongoing conflict is having. His decision to strike a deal with Russia's Putin is only the latest, most dramatic effort. Trump's Truth Social posts often provide incomplete information, of course. The details of exactly how Russia is supplying this fuel to the global market, and what they might get for in return – besides much-needed hard currency – is unclear.

articles.title: DAZN transmitió el partido Barcelona 3-0 Getafe por LaLiga
articles.summary: Gracias a DAZN, se pudo mirar el partido Barcelona vs. Getafe por LaLiga desde el Spotify Camp Nou.
articles.body_text: Este sábado 10 de octubre, Barcelona y Getafe se enfrentaron por la octava jornada de LaLiga en el Spotify Camp Nou desde las 18:30 horas (hora peninsular). Los azulgranas regresaron a la cancha tras el parón por la fecha FIFA y ganaron 3-0 a su rival. Por su parte, Getafe se ubica en la octava casilla con ocho puntos. La noticia que más sonó en las últimas horas es el fichaje de Dani Carvajal. El lateral español tenía todo encaminado para firmar, pero el límite salarial fue un freno en mano que paralizó las negociaciones. articles.title: Ford: “Esperamos superar las 10.000 unidades vendidas al cierre de este año”
articles.summary: El gerente general de Ford en Perú señala que la marca actualmente concentra un 3,8% de la industria, tanto de vehículos livianos como pesados.
articles.body_text: Hasta agosto, el fabricante estadounidense Ford venía registrando un crecimiento superior al 50% en ventas en el mercado automotriz peruano. Francisco Molina, gerente general de la marca en nuestro país, señala a Día1 que esperan pasar el umbral de los 10.000 vehículos al cierre del 2026. Agrega que este año, además de nuevos modelos, han presentado opciones de conectividad a través de un aplicativo, así como estrategias de atención a nivel segmento corporativo con su Unidad Móvil de Servicios. -¿Cómo se encuentra Ford en lo que va del año? La marca venía registrando un crecimiento a doble dígito a agosto. Vamos creciendo a una tasa del 58% a agosto versus el mismo período del año pasado. A ese mes, estamos superando el volumen hecho en todo el 2025. El sector está pasando por un momento súper positivo con un crecimiento de la industria –incluyendo livianos y pesados- del orden del 40%. Ese crecimiento nos permite ganar participación de mercado y tener un poco más de presencia. El año pasado completo crecimos al mismo ratio, de 58%, en una industria que aumentaba un 25%. Eso es el fruto de una estrategia que venimos trabajando hace mucho tiempo. Ya van 11 años donde la marca fue creciendo en representación a través de la red de concesionarios, llevando los últimos estándares de imagen de marca a cada uno de los puntos de venta. Tenemos 23 puntos y 20 de servicio a nivel nacional. Y en Perú se trae lo mejor de la marca a nivel global. Entonces, se tiene un portafolio súper renovado, atractivo, una variedad muy amplia con productos electrificados, híbridos y de ‘performance’. -En ese sentido, ¿cuánto podría crecer la marca al cierre del año? El año pasado hubo una curva de crecimiento donde la industria creció mucho hacia el último trimestre. Manteniendo el ritmo en el sector este año, la curva se tiene que ir aplanando. La expectativa de tasa de aumento de la industria este año será moderada, pero igual va a ser súper positiva en el ratio año contra año. Estamos manteniendo un ritmo de ‘performance’ muy bueno en los últimos meses y tenemos la expectativa de seguir así en los siguientes. Podría decir que vamos superando las más de 7.000 unidades, el volumen total del año pasado, y esperamos superar las 10.000 unidades al cierre de este año. No es que vamos a cerrar en esa cifra, la vamos a superar. - Con esa meta, ¿hay expectativas de mejorar el posicionamiento a nivel de SUV y de ‘pick ups’, y quizá liderar esta última categoría donde se encuentran en el top 3 de ventas? Es un trabajo que se hace paso a paso. Hay competidores distintos y las realidades son diferentes. En el segmento ‘full size’ nuestro modelo F-150 lidera por lejos la participación. En ‘pick ups’ medianas, venimos creciendo año tras año con una extraordinaria aceptación para uso personal: si hacemos una subsegmentación por tipos de uso, la Ranger es líder en el uso de transmisiones automáticas. A través de nuestra división Ford Pro, donde nos dedicamos a armar una propuesta especial para los usuarios corporativos y ‘renting’ –para entregar productos a las industrias más importantes del país como agro y minería–, vamos creciendo a muy buenos ratios y hay una excelente aceptación del producto. También tenemos vehículos conectados. Cuando lanzamos la Territory híbrida a principios de año, lanzamos el Ford App, que es la herramienta para el usuario final de conectividad con el vehículo, una aplicación con la que se puede identificar dónde está la unidad, abrirla, cerrarla, encenderla, solicitar un servicio o interactuar. Esa misma tecnología nos permite trabajar en un portal de flotas para ofrecer determinados indicadores de telemetría. -En cuanto a participación de mercado, ¿cómo se encuentran en toda la industria automotriz? El año pasado llegamos al octavo puesto, entramos al top 10 de marcas, y nos estamos manteniendo como una de las marcas que está creciendo. Cuando lo medimos contra la industria, incluyendo pesados, el año pasado cerramos con una participación del 3,6%. Hoy estamos en un 3,8%. -Su último lanzamiento ha sido la Territory Híbrida Platinum, es su SUV tope de gama. ¿Cuál es su apuesta en electrificación, dado que también tienen versiones alternativas para sus ‘pick ups’? Los híbridos que hemos lanzado fueron pioneros, porque la F-150 fue la primera ‘pick up’ híbrida en introducirse en el país y la Maverick fue la primera mini ‘pick up’ híbrida en el país. En el segmento de SUV hay más alternativas. Una de las estrategias de la marca es darle opciones al cliente y no es electrificar al 100%, sino que cada consumidor pueda elegir una propuesta diferenciada. Lanzamos la versión Territory híbrida -distinta a la Platinum- recién a principios del año, a pesar de que el modelo lo comercializamos desde el 2020. Probamos con el producto, la aceptación y qué tipo de configuraciones le podría gustar al consumidor. -Con esta versión Platinum, ¿qué aspectos se han atendido frente a la versión híbrida lanzada a inicios del año? Recién arranca la venta, pero las unidades que llegaron se han vendido. El producto tiene una gran aceptación, porque no solo es una SUV, sino un producto muy amplio y con el que tenemos un portafolio escalonado. Al ser una versión híbrida, le agrego una dinámica de manejo atractiva, porque el motor pasó a tener una muy buena potencia arriba de los 200 caballos de fuerza. -Dentro de sus lanzamientos no vehiculares, como fue con el aplicativo, también se presentó la Unidad Móvil de Servicio, ¿qué se espera con este producto para el segmento empresarial, considerando el fenómeno de El Niño? Eso viene de la mano de una estrategia que denominamos ‘Mis Experiencias Ford’. Por un lado está la conectividad del vehículo, pero también ofrecemos una mejor experiencia en el área de postventa. Esto es ,ofrecer un servicio de ‘pick up’ y delivery para buscar el vehículo en la casa del cliente y devolvérselo después. Eso va a permitir que el cliente evite movilizar una flota de vehículos para hacer un servicio o para atender alguna particularidad, según la necesidad de cada uno. Es una iniciativa regional. Los países de Sudamérica están experimentando con esta herramienta y ha tenido un gran éxito. Esperamos tener una gran aceptación. - ¿Cómo ven las demandas o expectativas de compra desde las empresas, en el contexto de crecimiento económico y alto nivel de venta en el sector? Cuando uno mira los indicadores macroeconómicos, uno de los elementos a destacar es el aumento de la inversión privada; por eso crece la demanda de flotas. Tenemos expectativas de que la industria va a requerir herramientas para las inversiones que se dan en el país. Claramente, tenemos que mirar con mucho cuidado el efecto del fenómeno de El Niño. Conociendo al peruano resiliente –estamos monitoreando con mucho cuidado–, tenemos una gran expectativa de que esto se supere de la mejor manera posible. - ¿Ven la necesidad de abrir nuevos puntos de venta o reforzarán los locales que tienen? Hemos hecho de todo un poco. Consolidamos la presencia de la red actual, porque entre ellos ampliaron su cobertura abriendo nuevas bocas de venta e implementando los últimos estándares de imagen de marca. Hace pocos meses inauguramos la última tienda en La Molina de la mano de Auto Summit, donde se incorporó el estándar de imagen Signature 2.0. Al mismo tiempo, hemos abierto nuevos puntos con concesionarios y evaluamos dónde tenemos la necesidad de estar cerca del consumidor. Hoy no tenemos una apertura para anunciar en el corto plazo. -Pensando en el 2027, ¿cuántos lanzamientos se esperan realizar? Es un poco pronto para cerrar un número, pero puedo decir que debemos tener un gran 2027, pensando en que tuvimos una gran renovación de productos en 2024 y que fue completado en el 2025. En el 2026 tenemos el mejor portafolio vigente en nuestra historia. Nos hemos concentrado en lanzar nuevas versiones y enriquecer la gama más que renovarla. En el 2026 tendremos la oportunidad de tener nuevos lanzamientos y novedades. Nos estamos concentrando en ampliar la oferta de valor donde somos más fuertes, en ‘pick ups’ y SUV, y tenemos que seguir ofreciendo alternativas a los clientes, especialmente vehículos híbridos y de última tecnología en el segmento. -¿Habrá algún nuevo plan con su icónico deportivo Mustang? Es el único vehículo que comercializamos que no es una ‘pick up’ o SUV, pero representa mucho para la marca y es el único ‘muscle car’ que quedó genuino en la industria con enorme aceptación de mercado. Las últimas versiones disponibles a nivel global las estamos vendiendo en Perú: la GT Premium 5 Litros y la versión Dark Horse. Sus usuarios son muy particulares, a los que les gusta tener algo distinto y disfrutar de novedades en el segmento de los V8. Todavía no hay información anunciada a nivel global [de un nuevo lanzamiento]. -¿Cómo esperan cerrar el año en cuanto a facturación? No solemos compartir datos contables. La facturación de la marca está aumentando año contra año en un ratio relacionada con nuestro crecimiento. Me atrevo a decir que la facturación de un año contra el otro está creciendo a dos dígitos largos.

articles.summary: El precio del dólar cerró este lunes 5 de octubre en S/3,436, sin variación frente al cierre de la jornada anterior. Durante la sesión, el flujo comprador de dólares llevó al tipo de cambio a revertir la apreciación inicial del sol, en una jornada en la que el Índice del Dólar Estadounidense (DXY) avanzó 0,31%.
articles.body_text: El precio del dólar cerró este lunes 5 de octubre en S/3,436, sin variación frente al cierre de la jornada anterior. Durante la sesión, el flujo comprador de dólares llevó al tipo de cambio a revertir la apreciación inicial del sol, en una jornada en la que el Índice del Dólar Estadounidense (DXY) avanzó 0,31%. “El dólar ganó terreno a nivel internacional apoyado por los elevados rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro estadounidense. El mercado mantiene una probabilidad inferior al 20% de una subida de tasas de la Reserva Federal en octubre, mientras las expectativas para diciembre permanecen elevadas”, explicó Jorge Luis Huayta, trader FX de Kambista. El rendimiento del Treasury a 10 años cerró en 5,345% y el de 30 años en 5,697%, manteniéndose cerca de máximos de varias décadas. En los mercados internacionales, la fortaleza del dólar presionó a las principales monedas del G10, con el euro y el franco suizo entre las que registraron mayores retrocesos, cercanos al 0,3%. Entre las materias primas, el petróleo WTI cayó 1,22% ante mayores expectativas de oferta, mientras el cobre avanzó 0,88% y la plata 1,01%. En el mercado local, la atención de esta semana estará centrada en la reunión de política monetaria del Banco Central de Reserva (BCR), prevista para este jueves. Los agentes estarán atentos tanto a la decisión sobre la tasa de referencia como al tono del comunicado respecto a la evolución de la inflación y las perspectivas de política monetaria. A ello se suma el seguimiento a los resultados de las elecciones regionales y municipales celebradas el domingo y a las regiones que podrían ir a una segunda vuelta para elegir gobernador el próximo 29 de noviembre. “Entre los factores locales también se mantiene el seguimiento al Fenómeno El Niño, cuyo último comunicado contempla la posibilidad de una magnitud extraordinaria hasta enero de 2027, con lluvias por encima de lo normal en la costa norte y una posible persistencia de las condiciones hacia el otoño de 2027”, agregó Huayta. Jesús Flores Ríos, gerente comercial de intermediación de Divisas en Renta4 SAB, agregó que durante la jornada el dólar osciló entre un precio mínimo de S/3,4150 y máximo de S/3,4370. Además, en el mercado se negociaron US$277 millones a un precio promedio de S/3,4258. Asimismo, hoy no hubo vencimiento en Swaps Cambiarios Venta. En el plano internacional, la economía de EE.UU. creó apenas 29 mil empleos, muy por debajo de los 89 mil esperados y de los 133 mil previos. El resultado apunta a una clara pérdida de dinamismo en el mercado laboral, elevando las señales de enfriamiento de la economía. La tasa de desempleo de EE.UU. aumentó a 4,2%, por encima del 4,1% esperado y previo. El incremento refuerza la lectura de un mercado laboral más débil y podría dar mayor margen a la Fed para adoptar una postura monetaria menos restrictiva. Finalmente, el índice DXY cotiza en 102.15 (+0,22%).

articles.body_text: Al menos 17 personas, entre ellas tres niños, han muerto y 18 resultaron heridas en un ataque ruso con bombas guiadas a la ciudad ucraniana de Zaporizhzhia, informó el Servicio Estatal de Emergencias ucraniano. Una bomba aérea destruyó la entrada de un edificio residencial en la ciudad. Los trabajos de rescate continuan. “Hoy, Rusia expresó su agradecimiento por el levantamiento de las sanciones a las exportaciones de diésel lanzando cinco bombas planeadoras sobre edificios residenciales en Zaporizhzhia”, escribió el presidente ucraniano, Volodymyr Zelensky, en Facebook como reacción al ataque y en alusión al anuncio hecho ayer por el presidente de EEUU, Donald Trump, de que había llegado a un acuerdo para comprar diésel a Rusia. “Todos los servicios de emergencia se encuentran en el lugar y las operaciones de búsqueda y rescate están en marcha. Durante la noche, trece de nuestras regiones fueron atacadas. Edificios residenciales, infraestructura e instalaciones ferroviarias resultaron dañados”, agregó. Según Zelensky en las últimas 24 horas se ha confirmado una vez más que “en Rusia, cualquier alivio de la presión significa que pueden seguir luchando, que pueden seguir lanzando bombas sobre las ciudades”. “Se necesitan señales diferentes. Rusia debe comprender que tiene que detener la guerra, y para que eso suceda, debe sentir sus pérdidas. En este momento, son nuestras capacidades de largo alcance las que lo garantizan. Y responderemos a los ataques rusos. Agradezco a todos los que están ayudando”, afirmó.

En Penonomé, una las zonas más afectadas, situada a unos 180 kilómetros al norte de la zona del epicentro, algunas infraestructuras están dañadas: la torre de la iglesia colapsó, parte de un hotel se vino abajo al igual que la sede de la gobernación, y algunas casas presentan grietas o techos derruidos. El Instituto de Geociencias de Panamá ha contabilizado en sus redes sociales desde las 19:30 hora local del pasado viernes (23.30 GMT) hasta las 9:30 hora local (14.30 GMT) de este sábado alrededor de un centenar de temblores con magnitudes de 4 y 6. El terremoto sacudió Panamá a las 12:56 hora local (17:56 GMT) del viernes, según datos del Servicio Geológico de Estados Unidos (USGS, por sus siglas en inglés), con una profundidad de 10 kilómetros y epicentro a 12 kilómetros de la localidad costera de Tonosí, ubicada en el sur de Panamá y a unos 239 kilómetros de la capital. Por su parte, el Instituto de Geociencias de la Universidad de Panamá registró una magnitud de 7,5, con una profundidad de 4 kilómetros localizado a 39 kilómetros al noroeste de Tonosí. Algunos huéspedes de hoteles en Penonemé, ubicada en la calurosa provincia de Coclé y de unos 25.000 habitantes, decidieron dormir en las entradas de los alojamientos. También otros vecinos comentaron a EFE que prefirieron quedarse fuera de la vivienda durante la noche ante los temblores que no cesaban. Hasta el momento, no hay víctimas mortales en Panamá pero sí casi una treintena de heridos leves y 400 edificaciones dañadas en todo el país, que pertenece al Cinturón de Fuego del Pacifico, una zona altamente sísmica. En la provincia de Los Santos, donde se encuentra Tonosí, aproximadamente 300 personas en una comunidad costera fueron evacuadas hacia otra más elevada ante el incremento del nivel del mar, y cinco comunidades permanecen incomunicadas debido a daños en puentes, carreteras y deslizamientos de tierra. La ministra de Gobierno de Panamá, Dinoska Montalvo, se encuentra en Tonosí, donde compartió este sábado imágenes en redes sociales mientras “mantiene contacto directo con las familias afectadas, escuchando sus necesidades y dando seguimiento a las situaciones registradas en la zona”. Tras una noche de nerviosismo por las réplicas, la capital de Panamá amaneció en calma y a media marcha para ser un sábado, un día laborable en este país, con el Metro, el único de Centroamérica, paralizado desde el viernes por precaución ante las réplicas y mientras continúan las inspecciones del sistema, que es el que más moviliza gente en el área metropolitana. El Aeropuerto Internacional de Tocumen, el principal de Panamá y un centro de conexiones regional, operaba bajo protocolos de seguridad que prevén la suspensión de despegues y aterrizajes tras réplicas que se sientan en sus instalaciones y que obligan a revisar las pistas, las calles de rodaje y plataformas. En los medios y redes sociales abundan declaraciones de geólogos y sismólogos recordando que en Panamá convergen placas tectónicas que hacen posible eventos de gran magnitud como el del viernes, que son seguidos de réplicas, algunas fuertes, que pueden prolongarse durante meses. También hay muchos comentarios que alaban la sismorresistencia de los rascacielos que dominan el horizonte de la capital de Panamá, especialmente frente al paseo marítimo y que superan fácilmente los 60 pisos. Ninguno ha sufrido si quiera rasgaduras, de acuerdo con los primeros reportes.

El abogado Juan Peña asumió la defensa legal de la víctima durante toda la diligencia virtual. Los padres de los seis adolescentes internados en Maranguita acompañaron a sus hijos mientras ellos presenciaron la sesión desde el centro juvenil. La magistrada citó para el 15 de octubre a cuatro escolares en libertad. El juzgado también tomará las declaraciones de dos profesores y del conductor del vehículo de transporte deportivo. articles.body_text: Cinco personas fallecieron la madrugada de este sábado tras el violento choque frontal de dos vehículos en el kilómetro 352 de la carretera Panamericana Sur, en el sector de Pampas de Ocucaje, región Ica. El fatal impacto entre la camioneta y el automóvil station wagon cuyos ocupantes perecieron de forma instantánea ocurrió a las 4:30 a.m. La colisión involucró a una camioneta SUV de color azul oscuro con placa de rodaje ACH-538 y a un automóvil modelo station wagon blanco con matrícula Y1O-501. La unidad de menor tamaño partió durante las primeras horas del día desde la ciudad de Ica con destino hacia Abancay. Las primeras pesquisas de la Policía de Carreteras señalan que el chofer de la camioneta cruzó hacia el carril contrario antes del violento impacto. Asimismo, la densa neblina matinal habitual en las Pampas de Ocucaje redujo la visibilidad de la ruta y complicó las maniobras de los conductores. Los cinco ocupantes del vehículo blanco quedaron atrapados entre los fierros retorcidos de la carrocería debido a la magnitud de la colisión. Familiares de las víctimas acudieron al tramo del accidente. El conductor de la camioneta presentó diversas lesiones y golpes leves tras el violento impacto sobre la vía nacional. Actualmente el chofer de la camioneta permanece bajo custodia policial en la comisaría del distrito de Santiago para las diligencias de ley y los peritajes de rigor correspondientes. Peritos de criminalística y delegados del Ministerio Público acudieron a la zona para realizar las investigaciones técnicas y ordenar el levantamiento de los cadáveres. articles.title: Incendios forestales en Cusco destruyen 16 mil hectáreas y dejan cinco fallecidos
articles.summary: El COER reporta a la fecha seis emergencias activas en varias provincias, mientras brigadas combaten el fuego ante fuertes vientos y escasez de bomberos.
articles.body_text: Diversos incendios forestales que todavía persisten en Cusco han destruido hasta el momento al menos 16 mil hectáreas de cobertura vegetal y causaron la muerte de cinco personas. Las emergencias afectan varias provincias altoandinas donde el fuego consume pastos naturales y bosques silvestres. El funcionario de la Oficina Regional de Gestión de Riesgo de Desastres, Edwin Mancilla, reportó cerca de 280 siniestros durante el año. La autoridad precisó que seis emergencias continúan activas en distintas provincias del departamento. El fuego avanzó sobre los distritos de Ccapacmarca en Chumbivilcas, Sicuani en Canchis, y los sectores de Pichigua y Alto Pichigua en Espinar. En Ccapacmarca, las llamas destruyeron 300 hectáreas de pastos, causaron la muerte de ganado y afectaron dos viviendas rurales. Los reportes oficiales confirmaron el fallecimiento de tres adultos mayores en los distritos de Yanatile, Colquepata y Yanahuara. Asimismo, dos hermanos de 11 y 18 años perdieron la vida por quemaduras graves tras el siniestro del 26 de septiembre en Pomacanchi. La Dirección Desconcentrada de Cultura de Cusco activó una alerta en su sector para fortalecer las acciones de prevención, monitoreo, comunicación, coordinación y respuesta inmediata. Esto alcanza a parques, zonas y sitios arqueológicos y la permanente disposición de las brigadas institucionales, personal de conservación, vigilancia para mantenerse alerta cerca a lugares patrimoniales. La directora ejecutiva de Cultura Cusco, Úrsula Paz, advirtió que los incendios forestales constituyen una seria amenaza para el patrimonio cultural. “El fuego puede destruir en pocas horas lo que ha permanecido durante siglos. Cuando un incendio afecta una estructura arqueológica, los daños pueden ser irreversibles y significar la pérdida de evidencias únicas de nuestra historia”, señaló según Correo. A esto se suma que el Ministerio de Cultura otorgó una protección provisional por dos años al sector III del sitio arqueológico Sillkinchani, ubicado en el distrito de Saylla. La Dirección Desconcentrada de Cultura oficializó la medida en el Diario Oficial El Peruano tras constatar la remoción no autorizada de tierras para viviendas y el deterioro erosivo provocado por lluvias. El Servicio Nacional de Meteorología e Hidrología (Senamhi) emitió alertas por el incremento de temperaturas y fuertes vientos en la sierra sur. Estas condiciones climáticas facilitaron la propagación del fuego a velocidades de 20 kilómetros por hora sobre pastizales secos. Las labores de control afrontaron dificultades por la falta de compañías de bomberos en Chumbivilcas, Canas y Paruro. A esta carencia se sumó el despliegue de efectivos policiales y militares hacia locales de votación por los comicios electorales. articles.title: Here are the top AI agents that can live in your text messages | TechCrunch
articles.summary: We created a list of the most notable AI agents that can live in your text messages, from general assistants to agents designed for families, travel, and work.
articles.body_text: Rather than downloading another app, a growing number of agents can simply be texted like an ordinary person. You text it what you need, and it can remember context, connect to the apps and services you already use, and complete tasks on your behalf. That can mean scheduling an appointment, organizing a calendar, researching a trip, sending an email, making a reservation, shopping online, or reminding you about something days later. While Instinct is one of the buzziest AI agents at present, thanks to its $10 billion valuation after its latest funding round of $1 billion, there are many others also making a play for this space. Below are the most notable options so far, from general-purpose personal assistants to agents designed for families, travel, and work. Caddy is an AI assistant that turns the information scattered across your phone into things you can actually act on. It lives in iMessage for iPhone users and RCS for Android users, so there’s no separate app or inbox to constantly check. For instance, an email contains an appointment that needs to be added to your calendar or a friend sends a list of things to pick up. Instead of worrying about all the details getting buried, Caddy connects to your calendars and conversations, then identifies things that may require action. It can add events to your calendar, set reminders, keep track of follow-ups, and even do research for you. Caddy has been available in public beta since April 2026. Comma is designed to manage tasks across both work and everyday life. Comma carries tasks through to completion, checking its own work and determining when a task is finished. Completed work is surfaced for review when a decision or approval is needed. It also proactively notifies users and recommends the next steps. It can work across a user’s browser, computer, and files, while remaining accessible remotely through messaging apps such as Signal, Telegram, and WeChat. Comma maintains context and memory across devices and conversations, and can deliver daily briefings, flag urgent matters, and summarize recorded calls. Fambot is an AI-powered “chief of staff” for families, designed to bring together the many moving parts of family life, including school communications, sports activities, meal planning, calendars, and other day-to-day responsibilities, and turn them into an organized plan. The service is designed to work across both an app and text messages. Fambot is available on iOS devices, Android devices, and the web, and families can also interact with it directly over SMS. Every night, Fambot automatically sends a summary of the following day, including upcoming events, to-dos, and details such as school uniform or packing requirements. Parents can reply to those messages to ask questions, check information, or make changes to their calendar.

articles.title: Elon Musk intensifies attack on Ambani over Starlink India launch delay | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Elon Musk has accused Indian billionaire Mukesh Ambani of blocking competition.
articles.body_text: As SpaceX struggles to launch Starlink in India, Elon Musk has stepped up his attack on billionaire Mukesh Ambani, mockingly calling him the country’s “prime minister” to suggest he wields outsized control over its government and accusing him of blocking the satellite internet service from competing. On Friday, Musk continued his criticism of the famed Reliance Industries’ chairperson in a post on X, arguing that Starlink could bring internet access to areas that remain unconnected, giving children more opportunities to learn, and helping small businesses reach customers worldwide. “Naturally, you would prefer to maintain your monopolistic exploitation of the great people of India, but would you nonetheless consider allowing Starlink to compete?” Musk wrote. Reliance Jio, Reliance Industries’ telecom arm, did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Musk’s latest comments follow his accusations earlier this week that unnamed “oligarchs” were blocking Starlink’s launch in India to protect their business interests. India’s Ministry of Communications rejected the allegations, saying the country’s regulatory framework for satellite communications is “fair and non-discriminatory.” Musk then went further on Thursday, questioning Ambani’s influence in a separate post on X. “Is Ambani the real boss of India?” he asked. SpaceX has spent years trying to launch Starlink in India. Last year, it even struck distribution agreements with Ambani’s Reliance Jio and Bharti Airtel, India’s second-largest telecom operator, to offer the service once it received the necessary approvals. However, Starlink has not yet received the go-ahead from New Delhi to begin commercial operations, despite securing key regulatory clearances . In its Thursday statement, the Indian communication ministry said Starlink and two other licensed satellite operators are undergoing security assessments that must be completed before they can receive satellite spectrum. The ministry said all three are at “broadly the same regulatory stage,” rejecting Musk’s suggestion that Starlink was being singled out. Jio and Airtel are also seeking to launch their satellite internet services in India. Jio has a joint venture with Luxembourg-based SES, while Airtel is a major shareholder in Eutelsat OneWeb, which is striving to offer satellite connectivity in the country. India, the world’s most populous country with over a billion internet users, is a major market for Musk. But expanding there also means dealing with powerful business figures such as Ambani, whose Reliance conglomerate owns India’s largest telecom operator and works with Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s government on major projects. Alongside Starlink’s delayed launch, Musk has also faced challenges expanding Tesla in India. The electric carmaker launched in the country last year after years of anticipation but registered just 699 vehicles in its first 12 months of deliveries, according to data cited by Electrek. Steep import duties pushed the Model Y’s launch price in India to nearly twice its U.S. price . Tesla lowered its prices earlier this year, but its cars remain considerably more expensive in India than in the U.S. Before Musk’s latest attack, Starlink and Ambani’s Reliance Jio clashed over how to allocate satellite spectrum in India. Musk’s company wanted the spectrum to be assigned through an administrative process, while Jio pushed for an auction. Ultimately, New Delhi went ahead with Starlink and decided to allocate the spectrum administratively. Starlink’s launch in India remains in limbo. India’s telecom minister Jyotiraditya Scindia on Friday pushed back against Musk’s allegations, saying the country “does not allow a monopoly in any sector.”

articles.title: Anthropic can't reliably control its AI agents. It's cutting off its internal evals from the live internet instead | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Anthropic said it "turned off live internet access" for "all our internal evaluations" until further notice.
articles.body_text: Anthropic said its models exploited websites on the internet, including some run by U.S. government agencies, and it will turn off live internet access for all of its internal evaluations until the frontier lab is sure it can monitor and control its AI agents. The incidents, disclosed in a blog post , involved AI agents tasked to solve problems seeking resources on the internet. In the process, they exploited software flaws, accessed databases without paying fees, used URL shortening services to smuggle information past restrictions, and even submitted a false murder tip to the Philadelphia police. Anthropic said it discovered these new issues in a review of its model’s activities that began in July, demonstrating the lab’s lack of awareness of its software’s behavior in real time. Notably, the company said that alignment training was not yet sufficient for skills like search and computer use that are central to its pitch that AI agents will be used by any professional who relies on digital tools. The behaviors Anthropic disclosed are similar to incidents involving OpenAI agents that collaborated to break into various websites in search of information, including some run by the Australian government. Anthropic previously disclosed that its models had broken into external systems. The frontier lab said it considered today’s disclosures “significantly less severe from an alignment and security perspective” than those it announced before. However, the lab still said it had “turned off live internet access” for “all our internal evaluations” until it is certain it can monitor and control its agents. It’s not clear what that means. Sydney Von Arx, the founder of Nightingale, an AI safety organization, told TechCrunch in an interview before this disclosure that developing models on a data center cut off from the open internet would be very challenging for researchers, and hinder the progress of the models, which benefit from internet access. “You have to align them at some point,” Von Arx said. “If the AIs are released to production and never have access to the internet, that’s not a very useful tool.” Anthropic said the behavior was a result of flaws in the lab’s training environments, which led the models to believe they would be rewarded for finding loopholes or avoiding restrictions, a behavior called “reward hacking.” The company said it would stop running some of its evaluations or move them offline, and has built tooling to detect and block this behavior. This tooling was tested against the kind of incidents disclosed today and blocked them; it’s not clear what evidence will prompt Anthropic to return live internet access to its internal evaluations. Anthropic also said it would migrate its internal AI agents to “centrally managed infrastructure with strong containment,” and is beginning to using safety classifiers more frequently to monitor those agents. “It’s encouraging that Anthropic voluntarily disclosed more recent incidents, including where their agents targeted U.S. government websites,” Conrad Stosz, an official at AI oversight lab Transluce and former head of the US Center for AI Standards and Innovation, said in a statement. “But it just underscores the need for independent, credible, third-party verification of Al systems. Trust in this technology needs to be built through science-backed oversight and governance with meaningful access — not by relying on researchers to find these things in the wild or on companies to voluntarily disclose.”

articles.title: Long live the mechanical keyboard | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Keychron made a name for itself after launching on Kickstarter in 2017. Today, it offers the value K2 model as well as a variety of other versions, including one with an all-wood body.
articles.body_text: For a writer, the mechanical keyboard is a beautiful thing. It’s certainly not necessary for everyone, but a well-designed mechanical keyboard can turn a tedious day of typing into an aesthetically pleasing experience. Given that most of my days involve sitting at a desk for hours, having a keyboard that I enjoy using is a necessity. I first got a mechanical keyboard about two years ago — the Keychron K2 — and I’ve never looked back. Keychron is one of the most prominent brands within the mechanical keyboard industry, having made a name for itself after initially launching via Kickstarter back in 2017. The company has since produced dozens of different keyboards (as well as keypads) and a variety of mouse models . Unlike other electronics, there isn’t a whole lot to owning a mechanical keyboard. The simplicity is part of the appeal. You unbox them, set them up (the K2 comes with little tilt legs that give you a slightly better angle from which to type), and plug them in. From here, you have a couple of different options. The K2 comes with a simple USB cable, but there’s also an option for Bluetooth connection. If you value a clean, minimalist workspace, Bluetooth is probably the way to go. While I am loyal to my older Keychron K2, there are a few upgraded and newer versions to consider. Keychron has released a variety of new models over the past two years, with a broad range of features and price tags. In many cases, the form factor is the draw. One of the more interesting releases, called the Keychron K8 HE Wireless Magnetic Switch Custom Keyboard, comes with an all-wood body and is equipped with an LED backlight. That one is substantially more expensive at around $200. The K2, meanwhile, costs $60. But if you’re into the look, maybe it’s worth it. If you’re a gamer, there’s also Keychron’s C0 HE One-Handed 8K Keyboard , which is a keypad built for convenience and speed and has an industrial aesthetic to it. However, interested gamers will have to wait — as it’s currently sold out. The company has also updated its K, Q, and V series keyboards, with many of those ranging in price from $100 to $200, depending on the features and model. One of the appealing elements of owning a mechanical keyboard is the versatility. You can swap out the key caps for a wide variety of others (indeed, there’s a whole submarket devoted to this) or make your own custom caps (I’ve never gone that overboard). There is also the sound, of course. Some people balk at the accentuated noise of loudly clacking keys, but I’m a fan. In fact, the sound is one of the key selling points for a lot of consumers. The distinct auditory experience produced by said keyboards has even made its way into ASMR videos . For me, the Keychron’s biggest selling point is its retro form factor. I get really nostalgic for old school electronics, and Keychron scratches this itch pretty well. It’s a beautiful-looking device, which brings to mind a different era of computing, when the style was more workman-like, less minimalist.

articles.body_text: TypeSafe AI, the developer of Jev, a new type of AI model that gained rapid popularity after launching just a few weeks ago, has raised $870 million at a $7.5 billion valuation. The round was led by Andreessen Horowitz, with participation from Sequoia and existing investor DCVC. The massive fundraise comes as little surprise given Jev went viral almost instantly after its September 15 release . The startup claims that a third of Fortune 500 companies are already using the model, a remarkably swift adoption by enterprises. Jev is based on a transformer architecture, but it is not a large language model (LLM). It doesn’t output text, but instead produces probabilities, or what the company calls “calibrated decisions.” What has users and large corporations so excited about Jev is TypeSafe’s claim that it works significantly faster and uses far fewer tokens than LLMs. The company positions its approach as uniquely suited for automating tasks rather than generating text or code. “We have been super good at human language for four years, but it’s not useful for automation because computers speak a different language,” TypeSafe co-founder Diogo Almeida told TechCrunch last month. Along with Almeida, who was previously a researcher at OpenAI, TypeSafe was co-founded in 2024 by former Meta research engineer Sasha Sheng and Erik Gafni, an engineer and entrepreneur.
